vocabulary.meaning: food made through extensive industrial processing and often containing many additives
examples: Ultra-processed food is common in modern diets.
Some studies link high consumption of ultra-processed food with health risks.

vocabulary.meaning: a substance added to food to improve flavour, colour, texture, or shelf life
examples: The product contains several food additives.

vocabulary.meaning: a substance added to food to stop it spoiling quickly
examples: Preservatives can extend the shelf life of packaged food.
Some consumers prefer products without artificial preservatives.

vocabulary.meaning: one of the foods or substances used to make a dish or product
examples: Always check the ingredient list if you have allergies.
The sauce contains only five ingredients.

vocabulary.meaning: the process of getting and using the food needed for health and growth
examples: Good nutrition supports physical and mental health.
Schools can teach children about nutrition.

vocabulary.meaning: changed from its natural state, usually during food production
examples: Not all processed foods are unhealthy.
Frozen vegetables are processed but can still be nutritious.
